reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added a new annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` to allow users to control native sidecar injection on a per-pod basis", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional annotation; no operational consequence if the operator does nothing.

proposed.statement: A new pod annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` (true/false) was added to control native sidecar injection per pod, taking precedence over ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS.
